title: Single-level realization and normalized finite-word interfaces
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a level $n+1$, and a scheme $T$. For the coefficient towers [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers], a SingleLevelRealization is an additive exact functor from fixed-scalar pro-etale $B_{n+1}$-module sheaves to towers, equipped with its level-n coordinate, zero other levels, zero adjacent transitions, and bounded-below etale-origin range after comparison and localization. Its derived lift is $J$, with the specified evaluation isomorphism and retained input origin. Given a projective-line presentation and its etale-origin comparisons [lem-sp-tower-p1-etale-origin-comparisons], SingleLevelComparisons consists of the realizations at $S$ and $P=\mathbf P^1_S$, the recorded projective coordinates and four compatibility fields, and natural push and pull isomorphisms pinned componentwise to the recursively defined words. The ordinary $F_n,G_n,\eta_n,\varepsilon_n$ are the existing direct-image, pullback-line, diagonal and splitting-trace formulas; singleLevelTrianglesStatement packages existence of these comparisons and conditional reflection of the two tower triangles. No object is chosen from a mere existence theorem.
